title: Kenai River Baseline Water Quality Project Data QA/QC
text:
Preface
This document is the online work-in-progress for preparation of data that will be used in the upcoming report, Water Quality Assessment of the Kenai River Watershed, 2000 - 2025.
Downloads
This report can also be downloaded as an Microsoft Word document by clicking on the ‘W’ symbol in the upper left corner. When the report is complete, it will be available to download as a PDF.
Github
All project files and source code are hosted in a public GitHub repository, which is accessible by clicking the GitHub symbol in the upper left corner.
This online report is not optimized for use on mobile devices, and is best accessed on a desktop or laptop computer.

title: 1  Introduction
text:
1.1 One year at a time
This project prepares one year of Kenai River Baseline Water Quality Monitoring data, collected by the Kenai Watershed Forum, for submission to the U.S. EPA Water Quality Exchange (WQX) through CDX. Once submitted, the data are published through EPA’s Water Quality Portal (WQP), where the report repository reads them for display and interpretation.
The pipeline is a template that is run for a single data year. The working year is set in config.yml (sampling dates and raw file paths) and in the year configuration chunk of project_year/<year>.qmd. Raw lab files for that year are placed in data/, which is not tracked in git.

title: 1  Introduction
text:
1.2 Pipeline steps

Part A: ingestion. Lab files (SGS metals, nutrients and BTEX; SWWTP fecal coliform and TSS; field YSI and turbidity) are read and combined into one data frame, dat. Lab QC rows are written to other/output/intermediate/lab_qaqc_data/ and excluded.
Part B: WQX formatting. functions/format_wqx.R joins site coordinates, sample fraction, preservative and container information, and builds Activity IDs.
Part C: QA/QC checklist. A 42-question checklist based on ADEC guidance, with data flags applied from reference/wqx_templates/<year>_data_flag_decisions.csv.
Part D: CDX export. functions/generate_cdx_export.R writes the upload files (results_activities.csv, project.csv, station.csv) to other/output/. It requires station and project files downloaded manually from WQP into other/input/WQX_downloads/.

Lookup tables (site names, analysis codes, analyte abbreviations, holding times) are in reference/wqx_templates/.

title: 1  Introduction
text:
1.3 ID rule
Upload files must use bare IDs with no KENAI_WQX- prefix, because WQX Web adds the prefix on import. The export script stops with an error if a prefixed ID is found.

title: Annual QA/QC Pipeline: 2025 Data
text:
Introduction
This document contains the complete data ingestion, QA/QC evaluation, flagging, and CDX export workflow for the 2025 Kenai River Baseline Water Quality Monitoring dataset.
The structure of this document follows the Data Evaluation Checklist provided by the Alaska Department of Environmental Conservation. Field observations that do not meet QA/QC standards are flagged before upload to the EPA Water Quality Exchange (WQX).
For the 2021 worked example (with full narrative and documentation), see the report repo: https://github.com/Kenai-Watershed-Forum/kenai-river-wqx

title: Annual QA/QC Pipeline: 2025 Data
text:
Part A: Data Ingestion
2025-specific notes:

Spring sampling: April 30, 2025. Summer sampling: July 23, 2025.
SGS EDD delivered as XLSX (Sheet8) for both seasons. No ALS dissolved metals supplement this year.
No BTEX (8260D) analysis in spring 2025; BTEX analyzed at 4 sites in summer 2025.
TSS from SWWTP: both seasons read from the Updated_Formatting sheet. Spring source is KRWF TSS MONITORING 05-01-25.xlsx; summer is KRWF TSS MONITORING 07-25-25.xls (skip = 1 past title row). The original spring .xls (wide block format) is retained in the same directory for reference.
FC from SWWTP in standard XLS format (spring: skip = 11; summer: skip = 10). Summer time sampled stored as HHMM integer.
YSI ProQuatro / Hach turbidimeter data: single file covering both seasons, read in below.
